title: a mockup was approved without matching what got built

human_turns.quote: Approved althouth I see your mockup does not show triangles. I expect implementation to show the new primitive.

body:
"Approved although I see your mockup does not show triangles. I expect
implementation to show the new primitive." (S19:H2) The mockup was approved
anyway and the mismatch was only caught by the human reading it, not by
anything mechanical. Nothing ties a mockup's content back to what the
implementation actually renders once built.

**Proposed change** — `conformance` should flag when a proposal's structure
changed after `mockup` was drawn without `mockup` being regenerated, the same
way it already flags structure changing after `experience` was approved.
